results.hashes: All 23 manifest entries verified. The attempt03 receipt records source input SHA 9ba7fc...a64c; that 2b source file still hashes to that value. The attempt03 native Blender file hashes to 01103e...b8fce, distinct from the separately preserved attempt02 file.
results.render_controls: Baseline and candidate receipts match exactly for cameras, lighting and render settings. Both record estimated, not calibrated, reference registration. Locked composite 1280x853 (aspect 1.500586); comparison renders 1100x732 (1.502732); source aspect is therefore close, though the source framing is not calibrated.
results.texture_and_export: 49 surface texturePaths exist and match their named hashes. The finish02 receipt's 14 hashes match same-named embedded GLB image payloads. Total checked = 63/63. GLB has 23 embedded images (the remaining two are inherited machinery maps); all nine exported primitives have POSITION, NORMAL and TEXCOORD_0. Blender inspection found UV layers on 6611/6611 meshes and visible slot family distribution including worn-bronze 844, black-iron 570, machined-steel 532, breast-armor 312, forged-steel 136, head-armor 116 and wing-armor 92 objects. This supports material family routing and data coverage, not rendered pixel parity.
results.visual_evidence: Candidate changes are legible in the same-camera pairs and preserve a recognizable mechanical bird silhouette. Against the locked full-bird reference, the candidate remains substantially simpler, flatter/darker and less richly layered; the reference's detailed compact feather-like armor, warm patinated metal and densely integrated avian head are not yet coherently reproduced. The July head reference remains a separate head-identity control.

material_gaps: The head still lacks convincing source-specific facial integration and detailed layered surface character in matched views.
Full-bird render remains materially short of the pinned source's rich warm surface response and dense armor layering.
Registration is estimated and no browser render comparison has been run; GLB data presence does not prove browser pixel parity.

evidence_reviewer.independence_limit: Single reviewer; conclusions do not substitute for outcome, safety, disruptor, negotiator or owner review.

rationale: Retain source-specific changes for continued Advanced development only: frozen identities, matched before/candidate controls, texture hashes, material slot assignment and static GLB normal/UV coverage are supported. Current visual evidence does not support coherent photoreal likeness or any full-goal, three-era, browser-parity, release or owner-acceptance claim.
follow_up: Use the largest blocking visual gap for the next bounded correction; preserve current native and source hashes. Re-evaluate with registered same-camera images and separately inspect browser rendering before making runtime-parity claims.
